description:
Because:

- GET /v1/account/sessions is deprecated in favour of /account/attached_clients.
- No legitimate Mozilla client calls the route.

This commit:

- Removes the route, its swagger doc and its metrics path entry.
- Removes its unit tests and the test client wrapper.
- Removes sessions() from fxa-auth-client and the content-server delegate.
- Reads the session handle from attachedClients() in the remote test.

Closes FXA-14625
